name: Forwardly
summary: B2B payments platform for paying vendor bills and collecting invoices by ACH, with a bill inbox and accounting sync.
best_for: small US businesses and bookkeepers who pay vendors and collect invoices by ACH and want a free account with an AP and AR inbox
skip_if: you pay suppliers outside the US, you need an ERP sync such as NetSuite without an enterprise quote, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The price page is clear about fees, but the headline savings depend on both sides being on the Forwardly Network. Fast payment options cost 1% per payment, card payments cost 2.99%, and the trial and the promotional pricing apply to new US businesses only. We have not tested the product.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-14 on forwardly.com/pricing, US dollars) Forwardly has no monthly platform fee. The free business account costs $0 a month and includes 10 free standard ACH payments a month (5 sent and 5 received), card or bank collection, AI bill capture, a dedicated bill inbox, unlimited users with custom roles, auto collect and auto pay, accounting sync, payment links, custom approval workflows and W-9 collection, with standard email support. The Pay as you go tier starts with a 30-day free trial for US businesses and adds unlimited standard ACH, fast and instant payment options from as little as $1 a payment, and real-time sync with QuickBooks Online and Xero. Enterprise is custom priced and adds volume discounts, API access, sync with Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft Dynamics 365, and phone support. The fee table lists standard ACH at $0.50 after the free payments, next-day ACH at 1% (minimum $1, maximum $10), same-day ACH at 1% (minimum $1, maximum $20), instant bank transfer at 1% (minimum $1, maximum $30), and card payments at 2.99%, which can be passed to the client. A $0.25 card settlement fee is charged per batch and cannot be passed on. Transfers between two businesses on the Forwardly Network cost $0. The page says that after the trial, new customers get special promotional pricing for 12 months from sign-up. We did not open an account, so tax and the price after the promotional period are not known.

free_plan_evidence: The free business account costs $0 a month and includes 10 free standard ACH payments a month (5 sent and 5 received), card or bank collection, AI bill capture, a dedicated bill inbox, unlimited users with custom roles, auto collect and auto pay, accounting sync, payment links, custom approval workflows and W-9 collection, with standard email support.
